snippet.title: TerraForge - Release Trailer
snippet.description:
Buy it on steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/24...

Press Kit:
https://impress.games/press-kit/overj...

About TerraForge:
TerraForge is a relaxed mining simulation game mixed with a bit of shop management. You dig for ores, mastering crafting items, research new blueprints, sell items and improve your shop while you slowly grow your own little mining town.

Features:
- Manage your mining operation.
- Run your own shop, sell and haggle.
- Market demand and supply system with dynamic market events.
- Build your shop's fame and attract more customers.
- Dig out and mine procedural mining sites to gather raw materials.
- Find old furnitures and reuse them in your shop to gain boosts.
- Use several different mining tools, each has its own advantage.
- Upgrade your tools to be more efficient and reach deeper layers to find rarer resources.
- Collect powerful relics and gain its power.
- Craft items to sell for profit and progress towards your goal.
- Unlock exotic blueprints and gain more reputation.
- Oh and don't forget to just chill and watch how the worm eat all the dirt.
